scripts.generate:api: bun --cwd apps/api generate:openapi && bun --cwd apps/web generate:api
scripts.check:generated: bun --cwd infra check:wrangler && bun run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json apps/web/src/generated/api.ts
scripts.ci: bun run audit && bun run check:generated && bun run lint && bun run lint:exports && bun run lint:md && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.deploy:preview: bun --filter @me-builder/worker deploy:preview && bun --filter @me-builder/api deploy:preview && bun --filter @me-builder/web deploy:preview
scripts.deploy:production: bun --filter @me-builder/worker deploy:production && bun --filter @me-builder/api deploy:production && bun --filter @me-builder/web deploy:production
